title: Freeze candidate, development, and scoreboard manifests
description:
## Scope

Deterministically create disjoint partition manifests with documented seeds, class counts, sampling rationale, source-use history, and exact normalized-text duplicate exclusions across partitions. Scoreboard labels are only available to final scoring. Commit manifests before optimization or collection.

## Definition of done

Specs reject ID and text-hash leakage, preserve partitions across reruns, report class counts, and prevent policy-selection code from loading scoreboard labels. Historical holdouts are explicitly identified as previously used.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Freeze candidate, development, and scoreboard manifests
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given candidate, development, and scoreboard rows share an exact normalized-text duplicate
    When manifests are prepared
    Then the duplicate is excluded or preparation fails before any model call
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Terra delivered deterministic text-free manifest construction and round-trip validation, official-test scoreboard selection with train-only candidate/development roles, duplicate exclusions, and prior-exposure guards. Independent foundation specs passed 28 tests. This story remains in progress: actual dataset-specific manifests and source rehydration must be frozen and audited before live collection. Typed fixtures are not a new benchmark or fresh holdout.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Prepared actual pinned manifests and independently reproduced them from cached Arrow sources: AG News 2048 candidate / 400 development / 2000 scoreboard, 500 per class, with zero prior-source-index and normalized historical-text overlap; Emotion 1536 / 600 / 2000 natural-distribution scoreboard marked exploratory. Full metadata/history participates in manifest binding. Included in the native workflow milestone; no new live model study occurred. Remaining publication/registration acceptance is tracked separately.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Pre-live audit identified a stricter firewall gap: core optimizer receives development labels only, but surrounding optimization/preflight currently rehydrates all heldout source rows. Keeping this story open while Terra implements development-only cache reading/rehydration; protected scoreboard IDs/hashes will come from the text-free manifest, with specs proving no official test Arrow file is opened by development selection. Public groundtruth metadata remains in the committed manifest for final scoring; it is not a prompt or optimization input.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Source firewall fix verified: optimization preflight/run/select accept candidate+development rows alone and never require the official-test Arrow input; full fixtures ignore heldout source fields after ID routing. Native optimizer still sees only protected IDs/hashes for scoreboard. Root145offline specs pass, including poisoned/unavailable heldout source regression and full fake development-selection-to-scoreboard pipeline. Public text-free manifest metadata retains groundtruth for provenance/final scoring; no claim that public dataset labels cease to exist. Actual AG8000 and Emotion12000 cache-only preflight rows complete without model calls.
